description: This Java source file defines the class CopySelectionWorker, which extends SwingWorker to perform background copying of selected table data to the system clipboard, often used for copying selected rows or cells in a GUI table component.

classes.name: CopySelectionWorker
classes.description: A SwingWorker subclass that processes selected data in a Table component in a background thread and copies it to the clipboard.

methods.name: CopySelectionWorker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worker with the given Table component.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Performs the background task of gathering selected data from the table and copying it to the system clipboard.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Resets cursor states in the GUI after background processing is complete.
